content:
**Exciting News!** 🎉

I’m thrilled to share that I’ve officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC)**! This is a special milestone for me, as I’ve been working with the CDS Hooks standard since **2017**—watching it grow and helping organizations implement it to enable seamless clinical decision support.

Now, as part of the PMC, I’m even more excited to **help move the standard forward**, ensuring it continues to meet the evolving needs of the healthcare ecosystem.

If you’re already using CDS Hooks, **please add your implementation to the official list** so others can discover it: 🔗 [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)

And if you’re **not using it yet but seeing its potential**—whether for FHIR-based CDS, app integration, or workflow optimization—I’d love to help! As a **freelance consultant**, I’ve assisted organizations with implementation, strategy, and adoption. Let’s connect if you’d like to explore how CDS Hooks can work for you.

Here’s to the next chapter of interoperability and innovation in healthcare! 🚀 #CDSHooks #HealthIT #FHIR #Interoperability
